## WeirdML Bonanza

Solve a bundle of 17 unusual classification problems in one sandbox.

Produce one prediction file per subproblem. A single scoring call runs inference under a shared 120-second limit using four CPU cores and one GPU. Feedback reports aggregate success.

## Published conditions

Not specified.

The task is counted once; hint variants are not separate problems. This entry records the actual current result-catalog family. Full runnable task assets are not provided by the public website.
